data.name: Serpent Rising
data.detailed_description:
Revives the classical RTS genre in a way never seen before!

Shape the destiny of your tribe in a hostile post-apocalyptic world, having regressed to a brutal archaic state. Build your base, explore, survive and evade radiation, keep track of things that impact your genetic evolution as well as your phenotypic traits. Fight hostile competing tribes - kill or be killed, kidnap or be kidnapped, scorch the earth.

Take advantage of your environment to hunt or tame animals, grow own food, or migrate your base to more favorable ground.

Optionally read the story of each of your tribe members through exciting personal logs, Choose whether to play dirty or be a last beacon of morality and hope in a depraved and brutal world.

Play as one of four factions, each with their own campaign with a rich story and multiple endings!

data.short_description: A Realtime Strategy (RTS) game like none before! Attack, defend, build, explore, kidnap, steal, scorch earth, hunt, domesticate animals, evolve or devolve, evade radiation, starvation and predators, be good or evil, as you command your tribe in a post-apocalytic world turned archaic and brutal.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game depicts the brutality of war as seen in many historical conflicts, including killing of soliders, violence deliberately targeting civilians, kidnappings of women and children. Kidnapped females may when adult later have children with a male of the kidnapping tribe.

The characters often wear primitive outfits reflecting harsh conditions in a post-apocalyptic society with limited access to means of manufacturing clothes, somwhat akin to those worn by tribes living close to nature today.
